final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and largely confirmed the original concerns. That narrowing improves the accuracy of the argument, but it is still a reinterpretation of the same evidence, not proof that the compliance condition has been met. A caveated posture could support compliant_with_caveats only if the caveat were merely a disclosure or bounded residual-risk issue consistent with policy. Here, the unresolved weakness, incomplete mitigation approval fields, and model-card disclosure mismatch remain live compliance predicates on the summarized record. Because those predicates are still unmet and unproven rather than simply acknowledged, the appropriate final posture remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
